text:
HTTP2::active
Description
This command can be used to determine if a request is generated by
HTTP/2. Returns 1 if the HTTP request is generated by HTTP/2. Returns
0 otherwise.
Syntax
HTTP2
::
active
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
if
{[
HTTP2
::
active
]}
{
log
local0.
"request from HTTP/2 client"
}
}
